title: Decadent Chocolate Chia Pudding
subtitle: Cookbook Special • Low Calorie • Meal Prep Friendly
description: Delicious, high-protein decadent chocolate chia pudding if smacking your fibre goal while indulging in a thick, creamy chocolate pudding before 8 am sounds like your style - this decadent, high-protein chia pudding is about to be your new bestie. o top it with a dollop of tangy yoghurt and fresh strawberries to seal the deal. prep: 5 mins total: 3-4 hours/ overnight 25g chia seeds 150g unsweetened almond milk 1 serving , pp calories 333 protein carbs fat fibre 34 g 22 g 13 g 15 g 30g whey protein powder (chocolate or vanilla) 15g cocoa powder 2g powdered sweetener* lopping; 50g low-fat plain yoghurt 20g strawberries instructions 1. blend the chia seeds, almond milk, protein powder, cocoa powder, and sweetener in a blender or nutribullet until smooth. 2. if the mixture is too thick, add a splash of water - it will continue to thicken as it sets. 3. pour into a glass or jar, cover, and refrigerate for at least 3 hours. 4. serve chilled with yogurt and sliced strawberries. enjoy! pro lip: swap ou4 almond milk for faf-free milk io pump up lhe prolein and creaminess/ time-saving 'ip: prep iwo of lhese in advance and enjoy lomorrow/ noles from the healthy recipe collection.

instructions.text: Blend the chia seeds, almond milk, protein powder, cocoa powder, and sweetener in a blender or Nutribullet until smooth.
If the mixture is too thick, add a splash of water - it will continue to thicken as it sets.
Pour into a glass or jar, cover, and refrigerate for at least 3 hours.
